"""Losslessly retain complete parsed calibration calls in bounded JSON files.

Dictionary shapes replace repeated field names; values and list ordering are
unchanged. Every encoded dictionary has one decimal shape-ID key whose value is
the values in that shape's field order. Ordinary lists remain ordinary lists.
The decoder below verifies the entire retained structure before writing.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

task = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = task.parents[2]
work = task / 'policy'


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text())


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def normalized(value):
    text = json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True)
    for original, replacement in (
        (str(task), '<task>'), (str(repo), '<repo>'),
        ('/' + 'projectnb/welfgr/fereg/runs/cmg-upgrade-20261021', '<scc-task>'),
    ):
        text = text.replace(original, replacement)
    assert '/' + 'Users/' not in text and '/' + 'usr2/' not in text
    return json.loads(text)


def pack(value):
    shapes, indices = [], {}

    def encode(node):
        if isinstance(node, dict):
            fields = tuple(sorted(node))
            if fields not in indices:
                indices[fields] = len(shapes)
                shapes.append(list(fields))
            return {str(indices[fields]): [encode(node[field]) for field in fields]}
        if isinstance(node, list):
            return [encode(item) for item in node]
        return node

    data = encode(value)
    assert unpack(shapes, data) == value
    return shapes, data


def unpack(shapes, node):
    if isinstance(node, dict):
        assert len(node) == 1
        index, values = next(iter(node.items()))
        fields = shapes[int(index)]
        assert len(fields) == len(values)
        return {field: unpack(shapes, value) for field, value in zip(fields, values)}
    if isinstance(node, list):
        return [unpack(shapes, item) for item in node]
    return node


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('platform', choices=('Darwin', 'Linux'))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    directory = work / ('results-' + args.platform)
    source = directory / 'run-0-0/results.json'
    summary_path = directory / 'summary.json'
    original, summary = read(source), read(summary_path)
    assert original['status'] == 'complete' and not original['failures']
    assert original['budget_compliant']
    assert sum(len(case['warmups']) + sum(len(block['calls']) for block in case['blocks'])
               for case in original['cases']) == 864
    if args.platform == 'Darwin':
        assert original['native_calls_started'] == 864
    assert summary['status'] == 'diagnostic_complete' and not summary['errors']
    assert summary['native_calls'] == 864
    assert summary['calibration_result_sha256'] == sha(source)
    assert original['manifest_sha256'] == summary['manifest_sha256']
    result = normalized(original)
    common = {key: value for key, value in result.items() if key != 'cases'}
    recovered = []
    for ordinal, seed in enumerate((2026102201, 2026103201), 1):
        cases = [case for case in result['cases'] if case['id'].startswith(f's{seed}-')]
        assert len(cases) == 48 and all(case['status'] == 'complete' for case in cases)
        calls = sum(len(case['warmups']) + sum(len(block['calls']) for block in case['blocks'])
                    for case in cases)
        assert calls == 432
        value = dict(common, cases=cases)
        shapes, data = pack(value)
        record = dict(schema=1, format='dictionary-shapes-v1', platform=args.platform,
                      seed=seed, native_calls=432, warmups=144, recorded=288,
                      source_result_sha256=sha(source), source_summary_sha256=sha(summary_path),
                      normalization='Task/repository roots replaced by logical tokens; all other parsed values retained.',
                      limitations='Recorded raw logs and numerical arrays were removed by the maintained runner after online checks. These are the complete retained parsed calls, not a raw-log or numerical-oracle reconstruction.',
                      shapes=shapes, data=data)
        output = repo / 'bench/results' / f'two-fe-policy-calibration-{args.platform.lower()}-seed{ordinal}-20261022.json'
        content = json.dumps(record, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False) + '\n'
        assert len(content.encode()) < 1_000_000
        if output.exists():
            assert output.read_text() == content, 'refusing to overwrite different evidence'
        else:
            output.write_text(content)
        reread = read(output)
        decoded = unpack(reread['shapes'], reread['data'])
        assert decoded == value
        recovered.extend(decoded['cases'])
        print(json.dumps(dict(file=output.name, bytes=output.stat().st_size,
                              sha256=sha(output), native_calls=calls)))
    assert dict(common, cases=recovered) == result


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Check retained Mac/Linux scientific outputs without any new native call."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

task = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = task.parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(repo / 'bench'))
import qualify as q

work = task / 'policy'
folders = {platform: work / f'results-{platform}' / 'run-0-0'
           for platform in ('Darwin', 'Linux')}
results = {platform: q.read(folder / 'results.json') for platform, folder in folders.items()}
plans = {platform: q.read(work / f'plan-{platform}.json') for platform in folders}
assert results['Darwin']['execution_sources'] == results['Linux']['execution_sources']
cells = {platform: {cell['id']: cell for cell in result['cases']}
         for platform, result in results.items()}
assert set(cells['Darwin']) == set(cells['Linux']) and len(cells['Darwin']) == 96
inputs = {case['id']: case for case in plans['Darwin']['cases']}
metadata = {}
count = route_matches = fingerprint_matches = 0
for name, left in cells['Darwin'].items():
    right = cells['Linux'][name]
    assert left['worker_signatures'] == right['worker_signatures'], name
    case_name = name.rsplit('-t', 1)[0]
    item = inputs[case_name]
    if case_name not in metadata:
        metadata[case_name] = q.routing_cases.inspect_case(work / item['input'], item['family'])
    meta = metadata[case_name]
    a = {call['execution']: call for call in left['warmups']}
    b = {call['execution']: call for call in right['warmups']}
    for role in ('never', 'force16', 'force32'):
        refs = {platform: folder / cells[platform][name]['references'][role]
                for platform, folder in folders.items()}
        for platform, base in refs.items():
            hashes = cells[platform][name]['reference_files'][role]
            for suffix, field in (('.json', 'head'), ('.npz', 'outputs')):
                assert q.digest(base.with_suffix(suffix)) == hashes[field], (platform, name, role, field)
            assert q.worker_signature(q.read(base.with_suffix('.json'))) == cells[platform][name]['worker_signatures'][role]
        q.compare_saved(refs['Darwin'], refs['Linux'], meta)
        count += 1
        route_matches += int(a[role]['route_trace'] == b[role]['route_trace']
                             and a[role]['route_hierarchy'] == b[role]['route_hierarchy'])
        fingerprint_matches += int(a[role]['fingerprint'] == b[role]['fingerprint'])
assert count == 288
record = dict(status='passed', comparisons=count, discrete_agreements=count,
              route_and_hierarchy_agreements=route_matches,
              exact_fingerprint_agreements=fingerprint_matches,
              numerical_rule='Maintained cross-host tolerances for RB/RV/RFIT and all retained numerical outputs; exact sample/drop/missingness and worker signatures.',
              result_sha256={platform: q.digest(folder/'results.json') for platform, folder in folders.items()},
              checker_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest())
output = work / 'cross-platform.json'
assert not output.exists()
q.write(output, record)
print(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True))

"""Retain complete calibration outcome, failed attempts and offline fit evidence."""
import collections
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import sys

task = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = task.parents[2]
work = task / 'policy'
sys.path.insert(0, str(repo/'bench'))
import qualify_scc as scc

helpers = runpy.run_path(str(task/'retain-policy-calls.py'), run_name='retention_helpers')
read, sha, normalized, unpack = (helpers[name] for name in ('read', 'sha', 'normalized', 'unpack'))


def accounting(path):
    fields = scc.fields(path.read_text())
    keep = ('jobnumber', 'taskid', 'hostname', 'qname', 'project', 'granted_pe', 'slots',
            'start_time', 'end_time', 'failed', 'exit_status', 'ru_wallclock', 'cpu', 'maxvmem')
    return dict(raw_sha256=sha(path), **{key: fields[key] for key in keep})


def observer(directory, result):
    host = result['host']
    assert host['isolation_ok'] and not host['errors']
    path = directory/'run-0-0/host-0'/host['observations']
    events = [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]
    assert not any(event['kind'] == 'error' for event in events)
    processes = [event for event in events if event['kind'] == 'process']
    assert processes and not any(event['competing_compute'] for event in processes)
    scheduler = []
    for event in events:
        if event['kind'] == 'process':
            continue
        raw = event['raw']
        item = {key: value for key, value in event.items() if key != 'raw'}
        item['raw_sha256'] = {key: hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest()
                              for key, value in raw.items()}
        if event['kind'] == 'reservation':
            item['validated_queue'] = scc.validate_reservation(raw, host['host'], 8)
        else:
            assert event['kind'] == 'census'
            scc.validate_census(raw['job'], raw['queues'], host['host'])
            item['validated_job'] = host['host']['job_id']
            item['validated_slots'] = 28
        scheduler.append(item)
    return dict(raw_sha256=sha(path), process_samples=len(processes),
                maximum_gap_seconds=max((b['monotonic_ns']-a['monotonic_ns'])/1e9
                                        for a, b in zip(processes, processes[1:])),
                maximum_duration_seconds=max((row['finished_monotonic_ns']-row['monotonic_ns'])/1e9
                                             for row in processes),
                errors=[], competing_compute_observations=0, scheduler=scheduler,
                limitation='Sampled coverage, not continuous or call-specific proof. Ordinary desktop activity retained.')


frozen_path = repo/'bench/results/two-fe-policy-calibration-20261022.json'
frozen = read(frozen_path)
old_records = [read(repo/'bench/results/two-fe-policy-development-20261021.json'), frozen]
already = {check['label'] for record in old_records for check in record['checks']}
checks = []
for path in sorted((task/'setup1-review/checks').glob('policy-*.json')):
    check = read(path)
    if check['label'] in already:
        continue
    assert sha(path.with_suffix('.log')) == check['log_sha256']
    checks.append(dict(label=check['label'], command=check['command'], exit=check['exit'],
                       elapsed_s=check['elapsed_s'], log_sha256=check['log_sha256'],
                       head=check['before']['head'].strip(),
                       source_before_sha256=check['before'].get('source_vector_sha256'),
                       source_after_sha256=check['after'].get('source_vector_sha256')))

platforms = {}
for platform in ('Darwin', 'Linux'):
    directory = work/f'results-{platform}'
    source = directory/'run-0-0/results.json'
    result, summary = read(source), read(directory/'summary.json')
    assert result['status'] == 'complete' and not result['failures']
    assert summary['status'] == 'diagnostic_complete' and not summary['errors']
    assert summary['native_calls'] == 864 and summary['calibration_result_sha256'] == sha(source)
    parts, cases = [], []
    for seed in (1, 2):
        path = repo/'bench/results'/f'two-fe-policy-calibration-{platform.lower()}-seed{seed}-20261022.json'
        record = read(path)
        decoded = unpack(record['shapes'], record['data'])
        assert {key: value for key, value in decoded.items() if key != 'cases'} == {
            key: value for key, value in normalized(result).items() if key != 'cases'}
        cases.extend(decoded['cases'])
        assert record['source_result_sha256'] == sha(source)
        parts.append(dict(file=path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(), sha256=sha(path),
                          bytes=path.stat().st_size, native_calls=record['native_calls']))
    assert dict(decoded, cases=cases) == normalized(result)
    platforms[platform] = dict(result_sha256=sha(source), summary_sha256=sha(directory/'summary.json'),
                               summary=summary, call_parts=parts, observer=observer(directory, result))

reviews = {name: dict(sha256=sha(work/name), result=read(work/name))
           for name in ('fit-review-high.json', 'fit-diagnosis-astra.json')}
fit = read(work/'fit.json')
assert reviews['fit-diagnosis-astra.json']['result']['fit_sha256'] == sha(work/'fit.json')
assert fit['status'] in ('fitted', 'unsupported')
fit_path = repo/'bench/results/two-fe-policy-fit-20261022.json'
fit_content = json.dumps(fit, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False)+'\n'
assert len(fit_content.encode()) < 1_000_000
assert not fit_path.exists() or fit_path.read_text() == fit_content
fit_path.write_text(fit_content)
record = dict(schema=1, date='2026-10-22',
    purpose='Complete fixed calibration, offline matcher repair and the single prescribed pooled fit; no public activation or qualification claim.',
    frozen_protocol=dict(file=frozen_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(), sha256=sha(frozen_path)),
    measured_source=frozen['source']['fereg'], platforms=platforms, checks=checks,
    independent_reviews=reviews,
    decision=dict(status='awaiting_user_direction', runtime_coefficients_installed=False,
                  public_two_fe_enabled=False, heldout_started=False, qualification_started=False,
                  reason='Valid prescribed fit, but zero supported calibration builds and necessary H>1007.3480190446954; changing the formulation/protocol requires a substantive decision.'),
    hygiene=read(task/'setup1-review/checks/policy-calibration-hygiene-1.log'),
    linux_job=accounting(work/'accounting/8244019.1.txt'),
    failures=[
        dict(kind='offline_matcher', check='policy-calibration-Mac-collect-1',
             diagnosis='Exact comparison mistakenly included the host available-memory limit. The narrow repair retains and validates each actual bound, while requiring exact accounted memory/work, routes and non-timing policy labels. Same observations reused; no native rerun.'),
        dict(kind='launch_preflight', accounting=accounting(work/'linux-preflight/8243850.1.txt'),
             log_sha256=sha(work/'linux-preflight/calibration-Linux.log'), native_calls=0,
             diagnosis='Output-path guard rejected a directory outside source target/tmp before creating outputs or entering native execution. Only output location changed for job8244019; binary, inputs, sources and budgets stayed fixed.'),
        dict(kind='read_only_local_inspection', log_sha256=None,
             diagnosis='A post-transfer process-list inspection was denied by the local sandbox. No data or workload effect; tool trace only.'),
        dict(kind='read_only_status', log_sha256=None,
             diagnosis='An initial read-only status check asked for accounting/logs while job8243850 was queued; those files did not yet exist. Tool trace only; no workload effect.'),
    ],
    cross_platform=read(work/'cross-platform.json'),
    fit=dict(file=fit_path.relative_to(repo).as_posix(), sha256=sha(fit_path), status=fit['status'],
             matched_observations=len(fit['observations']), unavailable_observations=len(fit['unavailable']),
             unavailable_reasons=dict(collections.Counter(row['reason'] for row in fit['unavailable'])),
             supported_keys=sum(bool(value) for value in fit['support']),
             supported_observations=sum(row['supported'] for row in fit['incidence']),
             build_incidence=sum(row['build'] for row in fit['incidence'])),
    limitations=['One mirrored block per cell is calibration data, not a performance confidence bound.',
                 'Recorded raw logs and numerical arrays were deleted after maintained online checks. All parsed calls are retained; independent raw-log reparse is limited to retained warmups.',
                 'No positive compatible-history or correction support may be invented from missing calibration cases.',
                 'The existing installed-plugin binding remains failed; development artifacts do not update release packages.'])
record = normalized(record)
scripts = ('retain-policy-calls.py', 'check-policy-platforms.py', 'retain-policy-outcome.py')
record['retention_sources'] = {name: dict(sha256=sha(task/name), source=(task/name).read_text()) for name in scripts}
output = repo/'bench/results/two-fe-policy-calibration-outcome-20261022.json'
content = json.dumps(record, indent=1, allow_nan=False)+'\n'
assert len(content.encode()) < 1_000_000
assert '/' + 'Users/' not in content and '/' + 'usr2/' not in content
assert not output.exists() or output.read_text() == content
output.write_text(content)
print(json.dumps(dict(file=output.name, sha256=sha(output), bytes=output.stat().st_size, fit=record['fit'])))
